# Project XiaoChun — Full Technical Documentation

> 100% browser-native 3D anime companion (二次元伴侣). Complete architecture, dependency inventory, AI inference pipelines, modular 3D engine, universal motion pipeline, i18n / SSR setup, and Cloudflare Workers deployment guide.

---

## 1. System Architecture

Project XiaoChun is a full-stack web application built on **Vite 8 + TanStack Start (full-stack SSR) + React 19 + three.js 0.185** deployed to **Cloudflare Workers**. Everything except Edge-TTS runs in the browser tab; the edge runtime handles SSR stream rendering and WebSocket Edge-TTS proxying.

- **3D Engine Architecture**: Decoupled into five modular sub-engines:
  - `src/core/vrmEngine.ts`: Master facade and lifecycle coordinator.
  - `src/core/vrmCharacter.ts`: VRM 1.0 lifecycle, spring bones (`VRMSpringBoneManager`), MToon material calibration, facial expression presets, and LookAt head tracking.
  - `src/core/vrmLighting.ts`: 6-channel lighting rig (directional sun, hemisphere sky/ground, front face spot, rim fill, leg fill, arm rim) with spherical sun mesh.
  - `src/core/vrmEnvironment.ts`: Procedural linework city (19 buildings across 5 archetypes, 5 stylized trees, wireframe ground grid).
  - `src/core/vrmRenderLoop.ts`: Adaptive requestAnimationFrame render loop with visibility-aware throttling and clock delta clamping.
- **Universal Motion Pipeline (`src/motion/universalMotionPipeline.ts`)**:
  - Unifies custom clips (mixamo, bvh, fbx, vrma), procedural natural idle/breathing, and AI co-speech motion (EMAGE) under a single pipeline.
  - Features dual-mode crossfade (smooth blending or instantaneous cuts), non-linear root displacement locking (anti-ground-penetration), and automated rest-pose restoration.
- **Application Framework**: TanStack Start provides file-based routing, full-stack SSR, and server-only helpers (`createServerOnlyFn`, `getCookie` from `@tanstack/react-start/server`).
- **Bundler**: Vite 8 with `@cloudflare/vite-plugin` and custom plugins in `vite/`: `localApiPlugin.ts` (TTS dev middleware + EU proxy), `dropDockerfatAssets.ts` (Cloudflare 25 MiB asset limit workaround).
- **LLM Layer**: Unified factory (`src/llm/chatWorkflow.ts`) dispatches between WebLLM and any custom OpenAI-compatible provider. Both implement the same `runChat(opts: RunChatOptions) → string` contract; new providers just need a `ChatProvider` descriptor.
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS v4 with `@theme` tokens (`brand-*` coral palette, derived from the default VRM model's hair color) + `tailwindcss-animate` for micro-interactions.

---

## 2. AI Inference Pipelines

All AI runs in the browser tab via WebGPU + WebAssembly:

### 2.1 LLM (WebLLM, default)
- **Engine**: `@mlc-ai/web-llm` v0.2.84
- **Model**: Qwen2.5 1.5B (q4f16_1, default) / Qwen3 0.6B (optional) — downloaded on first launch and cached in `CacheStorage` for instant subsequent loads
- **Runtime**: WebGPU (falls back to WASM with reduced throughput)
- **Streaming**: Chunked completion with milestone callbacks (`loading-webgpu`, `thinking` states)
- **System Prompts**: Per-language (`src/llm/prompts.ts`) — each prompt enforces a `🌐 LANGUAGE RULE` so the LLM responds in the user's language regardless of input language

### 2.2 Custom OpenAI-Compatible Providers (optional)
- **Activation**: in-app **Custom Model Service** dialog (chat-bar menu or top-bar gear). Templates: Ollama / LM Studio / vLLM / LocalAI / Generic OpenAI-compatible.
- **Configuration**: `name` (display) + `baseURL` + optional `apiKey` + `model`. Test connection probes `GET {baseURL}/v1/models` before save.
- **Storage**: Each profile is a record in IndexedDB `xiaochun-providers` database, AES-GCM encrypted with PBKDF2-derived key from random salt. API keys never stored in plaintext.
- **Unified active key**: `custom:{providerId}` or `webllm:{modelId}` in sessionStorage. Single source of truth, automatically migrates legacy `xiaochun.provider.active` keys.
- **Factory dispatch** (`chatWorkflow.getActiveChatRunner`): polls `ChatProvider` registry (`isActive` + `runChat`), picks first match. Custom takes precedence; webllm is fallback.
- **VRAM release**: when a custom provider is activated, `preloadWebLLM()` early-returns and `setActiveProviderId` calls `unloadEngine()` — releases 1-2 GB VRAM that webllm would have reserved.
- **Thinking mode**: passed through `extra_body: { enable_thinking: true }` (OpenAI-compatible convention used by DeepSeek / Qwen API / vLLM). Providers that don't support it silently ignore.
- **Output cleaning**: same `extractCleanSpeech` runs in chatWorkflow for both paths — strips `<think>` blocks, JSON wrappers, narrative parentheses, and quote marks.

### 2.3 Motion (EMAGE & Universal Motion Pipeline)
- **Model**: EMAGE full-body co-speech motion (PantoMatrix, [Yi et al., CVPR 2024](https://pantomatrix.github.io/EMAGE/))
- **Runtime**: ONNX Runtime Web v1.22.0-dev inside a Dedicated Web Worker (`src/motion/emageWorker.ts`)
- **Orchestrator**: `src/motion/emagePlayer.ts` — sentence-level streaming pipeline, temporal Gaussian smoothing, inertial tracking, natural idle blends
- **Universal Pipeline Integration**: Seamlessly handed over to `UniversalMotionPipeline` for crossfading, root coordinate locking, and zero-snap return to `NaturalIdle`.
- **Browser support**: WebGPU execution provider with multi-threaded WASM fallback for browsers without WebGPU

### 2.4 TTS (Edge-TTS)
- **Engine**: `edge-tts-universal` v1.4.0 (browser build of Microsoft Edge-TTS protocol)
- **Default voice**: `zh-CN-XiaoyiNeural` with `+10Hz` pitch (energetic anime-girl timbre)
- **Production endpoint**: Cloudflare Worker at `src/server.ts` — opens WebSocket to `speech.platform.bing.com`, streams audio chunks as `audio/mpeg`
- **Dev endpoint**: Same shape, served by `vite.config.ts → localApiPlugin` middleware with Miniflare
- **Emoji handling**: Text passed to TTS is stripped of `\p{Extended_Pictographic}` characters to avoid prosody glitches (Microsoft TTS tends to over-articulate emoji)

### 2.5 Chat Director
- **File**: `src/director/chatDirector.ts`
- **Role**: Orchestrates LLM → TTS → EMAGE as a single streaming pipeline. Each utterance triggers:
  1. LLM streaming token callbacks
  2. On utterance boundary: dispatch to TTS (begin Edge-TTS WebSocket, stream audio to user)
  3. EMAGE receives the same utterance and generates motion frames in lockstep
  4. Lip-sync (viseme blending) updates from TTS audio energy + EMAGE mouth keyframes
- **Cancellation**: New user message cancels in-flight LLM/TTS/EMAGE via token cancellation

### 2.6 Memory System (Client-Side Persistence & Extraction)
- **Files**: `src/memory/` (`store.ts`, `extract.ts`, `inject.ts`, `index.ts`, `types.ts`)
- **Storage**: Browser-native IndexedDB database `xiaochun-memory` with three object stores (`turns`, `notes`, `meta`). Zero telemetry or server transfer.
- **3-Tier Architecture**:
  1. *Short-Term Turns*: Recalls last $N$ dialogue rounds (default 6 turns, clipped to 180 chars) for immediate conversational context.
  2. *Entity Profile*: Multilingual regex extraction identifies user name/nickname, preferences (likes/dislikes), and key entity facts.
  3. *Long-Term Notes*: Keeps up to 80 summarized dialogue notes; retrieves Top-4 relevant notes per turn using n-gram similarity scoring.
- **Async Execution**: Turn commits happen asynchronously without blocking rendering or speech. `recallForChat()` injects localized memory context (`appendMemoryToSystem`) directly into system prompt instructions.

---

## 3. i18n & SSR Hydration

- **Library**: `i18next` + `react-i18next`
- **Languages shipped**: `zh-CN`, `en`, `ja` (each in `src/i18n/<lang>.ts`, typed against `typeof zh-CN` for shape safety)
- **SSR hydration**: Cookie-based — `@tanstack/react-start/server`'s `getCookie()` reads the `lang` cookie during SSR. Wrapped in `createServerOnlyFn` (`src/i18n/server.ts`) so the server-only import never lands in the client bundle (TanStack Start's import-protection enforces this).
- **Client fallback**: `readClientLang()` parses `document.cookie` for the same value, ensuring zero hydration mismatch.
- **Per-language system prompts**: `src/llm/prompts.ts` exports `XIAOCHUN_SYSTEM_PROMPT: Record<Lang, string>` — same prompt template, three localized variants.

---

## 4. VRM Character & Scene

- **Default model**: `public/xiaochun_v1.vrm` (18 MB, VRM 1.0). Generated with [VRoid Studio](https://vroid.com/en/studio) (Pixiv Inc.), subject to the VRoid Studio License.
- **Default thinking animation**: `public/thinking.vrma` (63 KB, VRM animation, license unverified — verify before redistribution)
- **Runtime VRM upload**: Top-bar "上传 VRM" button (top-right) accepts any VRM 1.0 file via `<input type="file">` and `URL.createObjectURL`
- **Scene composition** (`vrmEngine.ts → buildLineworkScene()`):
  - **Sun**: Spherical mesh at `(10, 14, -22)`, radius 1.5
  - **Ground**: 60×60 wireframe grid (`WireframeGeometry` + `LineSegments`)
  - **Buildings**: 19 procedurally-placed wireframe buildings across 5 archetypes (cube / tall-rect / step-pyramid / cylinder / cross)
  - **Trees**: 5 stylized trees across 5 archetypes (conifer / fan / layered / cypress / vertical-oval). Trunk height `max(1.7, totalH * 0.35)` so all trunks reach character waist level.
- **Lighting** (6 independent channels):
  - `dir`: Main directional (sun), `base: 1.0`, position aligned with sun mesh
  - `hemi`: Hemisphere sky/ground, `base: 0.6`
  - `front`: Face spot light, `base: 0.7`
  - `fill`: Back-rim Fresnel-style fill, `base: 0.8`
  - `leg`: Leg-only soft fill, `base: 0.45`
  - `arm`: Arm-only rim, `base: 0.5`
  - Global multiplier `1.1`
- **Camera**: PerspectiveCamera, default FOV 35°, position `(0, 1.5, 3.6)`, target `(0, 1.2, 0)`

---

## 5. Mobile & Accessibility

- **Touch targets**: All interactive elements ≥ 40 px on mobile, ≥ 44 px for primary CTA. Follows iOS HIG 44 pt / Material 48 dp.
- **Input field**: 16 px font (iOS Safari won't auto-zoom on focus at ≥ 16 px).
- **Responsive breakpoints**: Tailwind `sm:` (≥ 640 px). Mobile-first; desktop tightens spacing.
- **Top-bar icons** (globe / settings) wrapped in Radix Tooltip with `delayDuration={300ms}` so they don't flash on quick hover; icons alone on mobile, label-on-tap reveal.
- **Speech bubble**: Floats above the character's head, follows head motion via additive `transform` interpolation with `transition-duration: 150ms`. Max width 240 px (mobile) / 320 px (desktop) with `break-words`.

---

## 6. Build & Deploy

### 6.1 Build
```bash
pnpm install
pnpm build    # tsc + vite build → dist/
```

### 6.2 Vite Plugins (`vite/`)
- **`localApiPlugin.ts`** — `/api/tts` dev middleware. If `TTS_PROXY_URL` env var is set, forwards the request to that endpoint (auto-appends `/api/tts` if missing); otherwise falls back to local `edge-tts-universal`. Solves EU egress issues where Microsoft TTS endpoints hang.
- **`dropDockerfatAssets.ts`** — strips oversized assets from production build. Cloudflare Pages has a 25 MiB per-file limit; this removes `onnxruntime-web`'s `ort-wasm-simd-threaded.jsep.wasm` (26.5 MiB WebGPU EP variant, loaded from jsDelivr at runtime instead) and training data JSONs.

### 6.3 Cloudflare Workers (production)
- **Configuration**: `wrangler.jsonc` (`nodejs_compat` enabled, static assets bound to `./dist/client`)
- **Headers**: `public/_headers` defines COOP/COEP (required for WebGPU + SharedArrayBuffer), security headers, and cache policy (`/assets/*` immutable; root path `must-revalidate`)
- **SSR & TTS Entry**: `src/server.ts` — full-stack SSR router + edge-runtime TTS WebSocket proxy
- **Static assets**: `dist/client/*` served directly via Cloudflare Assets (robots.txt, sitemap.xml, llms.txt, llms-full.txt, VRM model, fonts)

### 6.4 Two Deploy Modes
- **One-Command CLI (recommended)**: `pnpm deploy` (`pnpm build && wrangler deploy`)
- **Git-integrated**: Push to GitHub → Cloudflare Dashboard → Workers & Pages → Connect Git (leave Root directory blank) → auto-deploy on push.

### 6.5 First-Run Notes
- WebLLM downloads ~400 MB model on first browser visit; cached in `CacheStorage` thereafter. **Skipped entirely** when a custom OpenAI-compatible provider is active.
- VRM model (18 MB) is shipped in the bundle; not lazy-loaded.
- TTS endpoint has no auth — keep behind custom domain to avoid random abuse.
- Environment variables: see `.env.example` for the full list (`VITE_EMAGE_BASE`, `TTS_PROXY_URL`, `VITE_PROVIDER_*_URL` overrides). Copy to `.env.local` and fill in; `.env.local` is git-ignored.

---

## 7. API Reference

### `GET /api/tts`
Synthesizes text to speech via Microsoft Edge-TTS (XiaoyiNeural zh-CN).

**Query parameters**:
- `text` (required) — text to synthesize, URL-encoded
- `voice` (optional) — voice full name (default `zh-CN-XiaoyiNeural`)
- `pitch` (optional) — prosody pitch (default `+10Hz`)

**Response**: `audio/mpeg` stream, `Cache-Control: public, max-age=86400`

**CORS**: `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`

**Example**:
```
GET /api/tts?text=你好&voice=zh-CN-XiaoyiNeural&pitch=%2B10Hz
```
